description.html: Gecko Nutrition Dragonfruit is a complete powdered diet made in Germany, specially formulated for crested geckos (Correlophus ciliatus) and other fruit-eating reptiles. This variety combines exotic dragonfruit with banana, offering a unique tropical flavor that geckos love. The base of the food is a high-quality protein blend of black soldier fly larvae (Hermetia illucens), mealworms and crickets, which makes up 11% of the total formula. Dragonfruit (10%) is rich in antioxidants and vitamin C, while banana (28%) provides natural sugars and potassium for energy. The food is enriched with essential vitamins (A, D3, E, B-complex) and minerals needed for healthy growth, bone development and reproduction. Crude protein is 26% and calcium content is 2%, ensuring an optimal calcium-to-phosphorus ratio.

Preparation is simple - mix one part powder with two parts water (1:2 ratio) until you get a smooth, creamy, pudding-like consistency. Place the prepared food in a shallow dish or on a feeding station in the terrarium in the evening, because geckos are active at night. Feed 2-3 evenings a week and remove leftover food after 24 hours to prevent spoilage. Alongside this complete diet, you can occasionally offer live insects as an extra. Store the dry, unopened powder in a cool, dry place.
